customUrlHelp: Internal addresses are never exposed publicly. Enter an intranet IP, port, or internal hostname; the same {param} placeholders as polling are supported.
customUrlInvalid: The custom target URL must be a valid http(s) URL
defaultTargetHelp: Used when a user group has no target override. Choose an enabled interface or enter an internal URL that is not exposed publicly; only one can be used.
defaultTargetPlaceholder: Search and select a target interface
defaultTargetRequired: Select a default target interface before enabling degrade
description: When a configured user group reaches its request threshold, later requests still use this interface's gateway path but execute against a target interface or a custom internal URL. Authentication, billing, quota, rate limits, and call logs remain on the current interface.
enableHelp: When off, degrade is not triggered; saved user-group rules are kept.
quotaHint: Keep the degrade threshold below the user group's request quota; otherwise quota rejection happens first and degrade is never reached.
roleHelp: Only enabled user groups with a request count greater than 0 trigger degrade. The window can be day, week, month, or total. Targets can inherit the default, use an interface, or use a custom internal URL.
roleRequired: Configure at least one user group threshold before enabling degrade
selfTarget: The target interface cannot be the current interface
targetAmbiguous: Use either a target interface or a custom URL, not both
thresholdRequired: The user-group request count must be greater than 0
title: Interface degrade policy
